findings.title: Notifications, live updates and analytics miss every payment completed off the normal path
findings.description: A completed payment is announced on two streams. payment.completed.v1 is durable (outbox, same transaction). The unversioned payment.completed is a direct publish after the response: skipped when the Redis publisher is not ready (the log says the outbox will retry — not for this stream), and never sent by the recovery endpoint or the hourly reconciliation. Wallet and commerce moved to .v1; notification, realtime and analytics still read only the unversioned stream. The catalog still lists wallet and commerce as its consumers; the drift check compares names, not consumers.
findings.root_cause: A migration to the versioned stream (audit F-2, Aug) moved the money consumers and stopped there.
findings.technical_impact: Three consumers see a subset of completions; the subset depends on Redis readiness and on which path completed the payment.
findings.business_impact: A paying user may get no "payment received" notification and no live update; analytics under-counts revenue.
findings.recommendation: Move the three consumers to payment.completed.v1 (each idempotent by paymentId), then remove both direct publishes; fix the catalog; make check-drift compare consumer groups.
acceptance_criteria: A completion through recovery produces a notification
No code publishes the unversioned payment.completed
check-drift fails on a stale consumer list
